verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents official SDKs across many platforms. Rollbar.js covers both browser frameworks (React, Angular, Next.js) and server-side JavaScript (Express), and there are Ruby, PHP/Magento and .NET notifiers plus an Apple-platform SDK module. Automatic capture is stated explicitly only for the Magento module, which 'should automatically report all PHP errors and exceptions'. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of mobile SDKs (iOS/Android/React Native) capturing crashes automatically, explicit statements that the JS and backend SDKs auto-capture uncaught exceptions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
